customSections.label: Which LCPS Calendar Is Shown Here?
customSections.content: This page follows the LCPS 2026–27 student calendar. LCPS separately publishes A/B rotation schedules and extended employee calendars. The current A/B schedule is available on the official LCPS calendar page. Staff members and families using a program-specific schedule should confirm the calendar assigned to them.

customSections.label: Major Breaks and Return Dates
customSections.content: These ranges and return dates follow the LCPS student calendar.

groups.label: Thanksgiving Break
items: Thanksgiving Break runs November 25–27, 2026. Students return Monday, November 30.

groups.label: Winter Break
items: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. Students return Monday, January 4.

groups.label: Spring Break
items: Spring Break runs Monday, March 22 through Friday, March 26, 2027. Students return Monday, March 29.

groups.label: Religious and cultural holidays
items: LCPS lists Yom Kippur on September 21, Diwali on November 9, Lunar New Year on February 5, and Eid al-Fitr on March 9 as holidays when schools are closed.

groups.label: Weather and emergency changes
items: LCPS posts closures, delayed openings, and early dismissals on its website and sends divisionwide notifications. The downloadable calendar on this page is a one-time import and does not update automatically.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From the Final 2025–26 Calendar
content: The first day moves from August 21 in 2025–26 to August 17 in 2026–27, four calendar days earlier.
Spring Break moves from March 30–April 3 in 2025–26 to March 22–26 in 2026–27.
The 2026–27 last day is June 11. The final revised last day in 2025–26 was June 12.
